newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Wolford surges in limp Vienna market.
newsitem.headline: Wolford surges in limp Vienna market.

text.p: Shares in luxury hosiery and lingerie maker Wolford AG jumped over four percent in an overall flat Vienna market on Thursday on what traders said was demand largely from Paris.
At 1018 GMT, Wolford was up 4.68 percent, or 125 schillings, to 2,795, making it the blue-chip ATX index's leading performer so far today.
The ATX index was up just 0.13 percent.
"But at its present level, you should actually be looking to sell," said one trader, who sees Wolford overvalued.
In September, Britain's NatWest Securities recommended Wolford a buy, setting a 12-month target price of 3,100 schillings.
The trader said that target was "ambitious." -- Guenter Kornfeld, Vienna newsroom, +431 531 12 278
